description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ikiriyagoda, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Bakulla District - Cad. Map No. 710031 (23/0067)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels (Nos. 38-46) in Ikiriyagoda village, including details about ownership (all parcels owned by The State), extent, class of title, and any encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
